people.name: Aristarchus
people.line: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner

people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Mark
people.line: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.

people.name: father_of_Barnabas
people.line: A close relative of John Mark.

translations.web: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
translations.bsb: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
translations.kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
